11. If an 11-digit number 546789x531y is divisible by 88, then the value of ( x - y ) is:

SSC GD 2021 06/12/2021 (Morning)
questions.s:
11.(d)

88 = 11 × 8

For 546789x531y to be divisible by 88, given no must be divisible by 11 and 8 both.

For 546789x531y to be divisible by 8, sum of its last 3 digits i.e. 31y must be divisible by 8

So, for this y must be 2.

Again, For 546789x531y to be divisible by 11, the difference of the sum of its alternate digits i.e. (5+6+8+x+3+2) - (4+7+9+5+1) = (24+x) - 26 = 0

x - 2 =0

x = 2

Hence, the value of x - y = 2 - 2 = 0

When the integer n is divided by 18, the quotient is x and the remainder is 6. When the integer n is divided by 25, the quotient is y and the remainder is 15. Which of the following is true?

questions.s:
We know dividend = Divisor*quotient + remainder

n = 18x + 6 = 25y + 15.

18x - 25y = 15 - 6 = 9.

So 18x -25y = 9

Option (d) is the correct answer.

questions.q: 4. The six-digit number 7x1yyx is a multiple of 33 for non-zero digits x and y. Which of the following could be a possible value of (x + y)?
questions.s:
4.(a)

Divisibility of 33 : the given number must be divisible by 11 and 3.

Divisibility of 11 : the difference between the sum of odd place digit and the sum of even place digit is either 0 or 11.

Divisibility of 3 : the sum of all digits of the given number must be divisible by 3.

The given number = 7x1yyx

(7 + 1 + y) - (x + y + x)= 0 or 11

8 - 2x = 0

x = 4

Now, (7+4+1+y+y+4) = 16+2y

Putting value of y = 1

16 + 2y = 18 [ divisible by 3]

So, required sum = 4 + 1 = 5

questions.q: 11. A 4-digit number x92x is divisible by 36 and a 7-digit number y569z04 is divisible by 11. For the maximum value of (y + z), what is the value of (2x + y + z )?
questions.s:
11.(a) 36 = 9 × 4

For x92x to be divisible by 4, last 2 digits must be divisible by 4.

x = 4 or 8.

For divisibility by 9 sum of the digits must be divisible by 9.

11 + 2x = 11 + 8 = 19, for x = 4

11 + 2x = 11 + 16 = 27, for x = 8

Clearly, x = 8.

For y569z04 to be divisible by 11,

Difference of the sum of alternate digits must be a multiple of 11.

(10 + y + z)  - 14 = 0 or 11

y  +  z = 11 + 4 = 15

(2x + y + z) = 16 + 15 = 31

questions.q:
If the 10-digit number x567y8459z is divisible by 90, then what is value of (x + y)?

A) 9

B) 2

C) 1

D) 10

यदि 10-अंकीय संख्या x567y8459z को 90 से विभाजित किया जाता है, तो (x + y) का मान क्या है?

A) 9

B) 2

C) 1

D) 10
o: Both C and DC और D दोनों
Both A and BA और B दोनों
Both A and DA और D दोनों
Both B and CB और C दोनों
questions.s:
A number is divisible by 90 if it is divisible by 2, 5 and 9. Then,

x567y8459z is divisible by 2 if it is an even number and it is divisible by 5 if its last digit is either 0 or 5. Then,

z = 0

Now, x567y8459z is divisible by 9 if sum of its digits is a multiple of 9. Then,

Sum of digits = x + 5 + 6 + 7 + y + 8 + 4 + 5 + 9 + z = 44 + x + y (because z = 0)

If,

x + y =1 then 44 + 1 =45 (divisible by 9)

x + y =10 then 44+10 =54 (divisible by 9)

Therefore, x + y = 1, 10

questions.q:
If the square of two times a boy's present age is decreased by sixteen times the present age of a boy, is equal to 240 more than the square of the present age of the boy, then the present age of the boy is:

यदि किसी लड़के की वर्तमान आयु के दो गुने के वर्ग में से लड़के की वर्तमान आयु के सोलह गुने को घटा दिया जाए, जो लड़के की वर्तमान आयु के वर्ग से 240 अधिक हो, तो लड़के की वर्तमान आयु क्या है?
questions.s:
Let the present age of the boy be 'X' years

According to question,

(2X)2 - 16 * X = 240 + X2

3X2 - 16X - 240 = 0

3X2 - 36X + 20X - 240 = 0

3X (X - 12) + 20 (X - 12) = 0

(3X + 20) (X - 12) = 0

X = 12 [X ≠ -20/3]

questions_hin.q_hi:
When the integer n is divided by 18, the quotient is x and the remainder is 6. When the integer n is divided by 25, the quotient is y and the remainder is 15. Which of the following is true?

We know dividend = Divisor*quotient + remainder

n = 18x + 6 = 25y + 15.

18x + 6 = 25y + 15

18x - 25y = 15 - 6 = 9.

So 18x -25y = 9

Option (d) is the correct answer.

4.(a)

33 की विभाज्यता : दी गई संख्या 11 और 3 से विभाज्य होनी चाहिए।

11 की विभाज्यता : विषम स्थान के अंक और सम स्थान के अंक के योग के बीच का अंतर या तो 0 या 11 है।

3 की विभाज्यता : दी गई संख्या के सभी अंकों का योग 3 से विभाज्य होना चाहिए।

दी गई संख्या = 7x1yyx

(7 + 1 + y) - (x + y + x)= 0 or 11

8 - 2x = 0

x = 4

अब, (7+4+1+y+y+4) = 16+2y

y का मान 1 रखने पर

questions_hin.q_hi:
If the 10-digit number x567y8459z is divisible by 90, then what is value of (x + y)?

A) 9

B) 2

C) 1

D) 10

यदि 10-अंकीय संख्या x567y8459z को 90 से विभाजित किया जाता है, तो (x + y) का मान क्या है?

A) 9

B) 2

C) 1

D) 10
o_hi: Both C and DC और D दोनों
Both A and BA और B दोनों
Both A and DA और D दोनों
Both B and CB और C दोनों
questions_hin.s_hi:
A number is divisible by 90 if it is divisible by 2, 5 and 9. Then,

x567y8459z is divisible by 2 if it is an even number and it is divisible by 5 if its last digit is either 0 or 5. Then,

z = 0

Now, x567y8459z is divisible by 9 if sum of its digits is a multiple of 9. Then,

Sum of digits = x + 5 + 6 + 7 + y + 8 + 4 + 5 + 9 + z = 44 + x + y (because z = 0)

If,

x + y =1 then 44 + 1 =45 (divisible by 9)

x + y =10 then 44+10 =54 (divisible by 9)

Therefore, x + y = 1, 10

questions_hin.q_hi:
If the square of two times a boy's present age is decreased by sixteen times the present age of a boy, is equal to 240 more than the square of the present age of the boy, then the present age of the boy is:

यदि किसी लड़के की वर्तमान आयु के दो गुने के वर्ग में से लड़के की वर्तमान आयु के सोलह गुने को घटा दिया जाए, जो लड़के की वर्तमान आयु के वर्ग से 240 अधिक हो, तो लड़के की वर्तमान आयु क्या है?
questions_hin.s_hi:
Let the present age of the boy be 'X' years

According to question,

(2X)2 - 16 * X = 240 + X2

3X2 - 16X - 240 = 0

3X2 - 36X + 20X - 240 = 0

3X (X - 12) + 20 (X - 12) = 0

(3X + 20) (X - 12) = 0

X = 12 [X ≠ -20/3]
